name: InStore shipping method
description: Allow customers to place order online and receive their goods at predefined places
project_description: InStore shipping method is an Arch Shipping submodule providing a click-and-collect option: customers order online and pick the goods up at a predefined store address. It registers an `instore` ShippingMethod plugin that returns a free (zero) shipping price, and a small admin UI (under the shipping-methods settings, gated by 'administer shipping methods') to manage the list of pickup addresses in a KeyValue store.
